closures.subject: human_impact_contract_structural_validation
closures.scope: Local structural safeguards declared by contracts/human_impact_cross_repo.v1.json and tools/validate_human_impact_cross_repo.py at the assessed revision.
closures.claim_boundary: Does not prove legal compliance, ethical adequacy, social acceptance, clinical safety, child safety, environmental harmlessness, or live cross-repository interoperability.

closures.subject: pull_request_generic_validation_at_assessed_revision
closures.scope: PR Validation workflow only at the assessed revision.
closures.claim_boundary: Does not override other failed or unobserved gates.

closures.subject: source_gap_audit_at_assessed_revision
closures.scope: Source Gap Audit workflow only at the assessed revision.
closures.claim_boundary: No executable source-gap finding from this gate is not equivalent to runtime, production readiness, or absence of epistemic uncertainty.

open_items.subject: live_cross_repo_ethics_receipt
open_items.reason: No live receipt binding exact producer and consumer revisions with an actual human-impact record was evidenced.
open_items.exit_criterion: Execute exact producer and consumer revisions together with an actual human-impact record and preserve the resulting immutable receipt.

open_items.subject: legal_or_external_compliance
open_items.reason: Structural CI cannot certify legal compliance or external standards conformity.
open_items.exit_criterion: Requirement-by-requirement external or qualified review with evidence, findings, remediation status, and signed/identifiable assessment record as applicable.

open_items.subject: documentation_workflow
open_items.reason: Observed Documentation workflow failed at the assessed revision.
open_items.exit_criterion: A new exact-revision Documentation workflow run concludes success after the failure is corrected or formally dispositioned without weakening the gate.

open_items.subject: merge_authorization
open_items.reason: At least one observed gate failed; pull request is draft; branch-protection requirements were not independently readable in this assessment.
open_items.exit_criterion: No observed failed gate for the candidate revision, draft/review state resolved according to repository governance, and required-check policy observed or explicitly left unclaimed.

open_items.subject: branch_protection_required_checks
open_items.reason: Branch protection endpoint was not accessible to the assessment connector.
open_items.exit_criterion: Read the authoritative branch protection/ruleset configuration or obtain an equivalent repository-admin evidence record.
